findings.text: §14 now says "The own-session limit is applied in `RowPolicy` … A stale arrival opener released for another session's run therefore still prints no launch", but `RowPolicy` applies `_is_own_start` at only one place, `_resolve_arrival` (reckon/crew/ticker.py:1585); an arrival hold that never resolves is released by `_release_expired` (ticker.py:1506-1511), and a run that moves without a `dispatched` left side releases its opener at ticker.py:1723 — both before any session test, for any session's run — so an arrival opener (`(None,"dispatched")`, pane word `working`) qualifies as "the first row of an attempt that reaches the `working` pane word" and would print a peer session's launch once `stream_carries` carries launches
